title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: Playback of steps stage2–stage4; pressure-injury.jsx Column wound wrapper; kit.jsx .dg-fade
findings.title: The fade animation moves wounds across tissue boundaries
findings.problem: The wound entrance is not opacity-only: .dg-fade starts at translateY(6px). Stage 2's final floor is y=126 and fat begins at y=130, so its early visible frames extend into fat. The opening also starts below the skin surface, while the depth marker remains at its final position. The supplied finished-state screenshots cannot expose this error.
findings.fix: Give wound geometry an opacity-only entrance with no translation or scaling. Test intermediate playback frames against the tissue boundaries and depth markers.

findings.where: Images 1, 7, 9 and 15; step other; UNSTAGEABLE constant, caption and narration
findings.title: Unstageable loses its full-thickness qualifier
findings.problem: Fact 6 correctly identifies full-thickness skin and tissue loss, but the visible card, caption and narration only describe an obscured base. That leaves the defining distinction unstated in the actual lesson: the injury is full-thickness; its extent, not simply its visibility, is undetermined.
findings.fix: Use: "Unstageable: full-thickness skin and tissue loss whose extent cannot be confirmed because slough or eschar obscures it." Retain the distinction that slough may be present in a stageable wound when it does not obscure the extent of loss.

assessment: Fix the wound-entry animation before publication: it can briefly depict Stage 2 extending into fat. The delivered unstageable explanation also omits an important qualifier.
